comments.note: Added view lifecycle template rule (AC1) to constraints.md UI & MVVM section. Rule codifies the OnLoaded/OnUnloaded pattern: constructor subscribes Loaded/Unloaded; OnLoaded creates fresh CancellationTokenSource, calls vm.LoadAsync in try/catch(OperationCanceledException)+catch(Exception); OnUnloaded unsubscribes event handlers, cancels and disposes CTS. Cross-references MoviesListView.axaml.cs as canonical reference. Pattern verified directly against source.

Added INNER JOIN aggregation rule (AC2) to constraints.md DSL Filter Language section (after the existing DapperMovieRepository rules at the movies.review entry). Placed in DSL Filter Language section to co-locate with other DapperMovieRepository SQL conventions — all existing DapperMovieRepository SQL rules already reside there, not in the Database section. WP-007 spec said 'Database section' but following the established co-location convention is more maintainable.

Removed 'SettingsViewModel has no unit tests' open item (AC3) — WP-003 added all three recommended tests (SaveCommand_DoesNotCallThemeService_OnSecondSave_WhenThemeUnchanged, CancelCommand_DoesNotCallObfuscationVmLoadAsync, SaveCommand_RetriesThemeService_IfPreviousSetAsyncThrew). The open item is fully resolved.

Updated the MysqlDumpBackupService ProcessStartInfo.ArgumentList constraint in constraints.md to remove the stale '-p{password}' mention and document the --defaults-extra-file credential file approach. The prior constraint incorrectly described the pre-WP-006 behavior. This was an additional documentation gap not listed in the WP-007 spec but discovered during review — leaving the incorrect text would actively mislead future contributors.

AC4 (BackupCancelCommand + HasErrors) and AC5 (BuildStartInfo 4-params) and AC6 (SanitizeDatabaseName) were all addressed during prior WP-004 and WP-006 documentation passes. Verified all entries are present in api-surface.md at this pass.
